hypothesis: H-O2: halo-pruned lidar step_max peaks (catalogue halo <= 2 px, per fold, visible only) raise hide-and-recover pooled DTI
mechanism: Lidar scarp crests (USGS 3DEP step_max) give dots; dots within 2 px of the visible catalogue are removed per fold, so emitted dots sit where a new (non-catalogue) fault would have to be.
named_non_fault_mimic: Multi-strand fault zones: unmapped strands sit within 2 px of mapped ones (the GPC-Z mechanism). Pruning those would delete real strands. Also fan-head and terrace edges mimic step_max.
